verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only local capabilities: background commands, subagents and monitors running alongside the conversation, an OS-level sandbox (Landlock/Seatbelt), and git worktree isolation. None of it documents delegating tasks to a remote or cloud execution environment, so these features are adjacent rather than the story's capability. The community reports of repository uploads to a cloud bucket concern data transfer, not cloud task execution, and do not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
